full_judgment: 9. Mr Abdul Quayum, the learned Advocate appearing with Mr Md Ali Reza on behalf of the petitioners, supports the Rule and submits that the learned Judges of the Courts below misconstrued the provisions of sections 12(2), 26C and 146A(3) of the BT Act, thereby came to an erroneous finding causing serious miscarriage of justice. The learned Counsel adds that the Courts below committed an error of law in holding that the plaintiffs' suit was barred by limitation, inasmuch as the suit was not filed within six years from the date of knowledge of the auction sale. The learned Counsel further submits that the Courts below committed an error of law in not considering the presumption of service of notice of the plaintiffs' kabala dated 14-6-1933 upon the superior landlords under section 12 of the Bengal Tenancy Act. He adds that the Courts below committed an error of law in not finding that the entire tenancy was not represented under section 146A of the Bengal Tenancy Act.
